name: context-engine-session-worker-deploy
description: Isolated, checksummed Deploy to Cloudflare package for a user-owned Context Engine Session Worker

GROUP_KV.description: A new KV namespace owned by your Cloudflare account. It stores this session's canonical config, encrypted secret envelope, questions, responses, groups, and indexes.

DEFAULT_SESSION_SLUG.description: The exact Context Engine session slug, for example `my-session`. It must match the slug used in Context Engine.

BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_ADDRESS.description: The Ethereum-style admin address shown by Context Engine after passkey login. This is public authority metadata, not a private key.

TOKEN_HMAC_SECRET.description: Paste the first independent 64-hex setup secret generated by Context Engine. It signs short-lived Session Worker login tokens.

CE_STORAGE_ENVELOPE_KEK.description: Paste the second independent 64-hex setup secret generated by Context Engine. It encrypts the session-secret envelope.

CE_SESSION_COORDINATOR.description: A Durable Object namespace owned by your account. It serializes signed session writes and safe retries.
